Title: Q: Fast Reaction vs Hidden Lurker?

Messages.Author: Creature
Messages.Body:
I tried looking thru posts and couldnt find the answer to this one. it
popped up during a game last weekend.

What happens when, after a combat bewteen acting minion A and blocking
minion B, acting meth plays a hidden lurker and blocker plays fast
reaction (both meths have an untapped ready vampire).

Which combat happens first?

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:



> Which combat happens first?

I think the Hidden Lurker "happens" first, and resolves, before the Fast
Reaction can be played.

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:


Correct. The acting player has the first chance to play any effects so he will
have the chance to play a Hidden Lurker before a Fast Reaction can be played.

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
"Halcyan 2" <halc...@aol.com> wrote in message
news:20030422132401...@mb-m19.aol.com...


Note that if Hidden Lurker is played, it will not be possible to
play Fast Reaction during the same action, since the combat
involving the Hidden Lurker won't have an "acting" vampire for
Fast Reaction to target.

I'm sure Halcyan knows this, but just in case anyone else wasn't
aware. :-)

Josh

Fine! You want to get picky Josh! Then take this!

Actually, it is still possible to play Fast Reaction during the same action
even if Hidden Lurker is played - if the Hidden Lurker is canceled by something
like a Direct Intervention. In that case, the Hidden Lurker is actually played
(but you don't get the effect), and still allowing Fast Reaction to be played.

> the acting minion and the blocking minion.

To expand on Scott's answer: The original acting minion is indeed
still "the one true acting minion" until that action is totally
completed (after all combats are done and nobody wants to do
anything else "inside" the action).

However, because Fast Reaction's card text says "Only usable
after a combat between a blocking minion you control other than
this vampire and the acting minion", it's not playable if the
combat that just finished didn't include that "one true acting
minion".

See? :-)

Josh
